children: Walmart's third-quarter results helped clean up some of the questions investors had after the second quarter, Deutsche Bank analysts say. "After a noisier 2Q, WMT did what it needed to in 3Q, delivering a clean quarter," they say. Gains were led by Walmart's grocery business, driving sequential same-store sales growth and expansion in gross margins. The results have made the analysts more optimistic about 2027. They see opportunities for growth to accelerate and gross margins to improve, despite rising costs from fuel and investments. (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
